story.heading: Built around outcomes, not features.
story.summary: MeU was founded on a simple principle: technology should serve the business, not the other way around.
story.body: We started as a team of engineers and consultants who were frustrated by the gap between strategy and execution. Too many transformation initiatives produced slides instead of working systems. Too many software projects lost the connection to the operational result they were supposed to deliver. We built MeU to close that gap — to connect business design with engineering, so every solution has a clear purpose and a practical route into daily work.
